trust_assumption: Native/delegate execution is trusted-local. These probes test admission, attribution and evidence, not OS isolation. Native internal tools and helpers need no per-edit CC wrapping.

findings.title: Overlapping workspace roots bypass exclusive leases and misattribute edits
findings.reproduction: Start outer delegate and hold it with threading.Event. While it owns parent workspace lease, call inner on child path using same Host/store. Inner edits src/file.py and returns. Release outer. Compare against same-root control call.
findings.outcome: Same-root control blocks RESOURCE_BUSY. Child-root call succeeds and edits file; outer call then fails UNDECLARED_EFFECT due to unrelated child write. Exact string path lease does not implement nonoverlapping path assignment.
findings.impact: Concurrent writers can overwrite each other under overlapping roots; observers are assigned changes they did not make. No hostile native execution is required.
findings.minimum_general_fix: Reserve canonical filesystem scopes atomically and reject ancestor/descendant overlap against all active/unreconciled scopes before dispatch. Preserve concurrency for independent worktrees. Define scoped lease inheritance for intentional nested calls rather than allowing accidental overlaps.

findings.title: Generic snapshot is insufficient to identify coding source and dependency state
findings.reproduction: Initialize Git repository. Save HEAD and Host snapshot. Registered callback creates an empty commit and writes .venv/installed-package.dist-info. Compare HEAD and snapshots after successful call.
findings.outcome: HEAD changes, dependency file is created, yet snapshot is identical and observed workspace changes is empty. Receipt contains file-byte snapshot but no Git starting commit/index/mode state.
findings.impact: The coding contract asks for starting commit plus dirty state, modes and required external objects. Host generic observations and the happy-path native fixture do not establish that evidence. This is an evidence completeness gap, not a native sandbox bypass; section 03 already admits workspace-diff limits.
findings.minimum_general_fix: Add coding-specific evidence capture/policy: Git HEAD/index/modes plus dirty/untracked/binary state, explicit dependency environment/lock identity and relevant external objects. Mark absent evidence explicitly and avoid implying generic snapshots fully identify the tested tree or environment. Keep ignored caches excluded from ordinary source scanning.

new_finding.title: Late adapter response overwrites reconciled terminal receipt and discards history

attempted_reconciliation.note: Execution owner completed all work and stopped. Awaiting delivery of buffered adapter response.

new_finding.reproduction: Delegate completes its only filesystem edit, signals execution owner is stopped, then waits before delivering buffered result. Main thread reconciles running call with truthful stopped attestation. Reconciliation returns failed RECONCILED_STOP plus reconciliation history. Let delegate return buffered outcome=ok. Call finalizer writes its stale local receipt over the reconciled DB record.
new_finding.outcome: Durable status becomes succeeded; reconciliations field disappears. Reconciliation artifact remains on disk but canonical receipt contradicts it.
new_finding.minimum_general_fix: Finalize call state under atomic version/state check. A terminal reconciled record must remain canonical, and late results must append historical observations without dropping reconciliation or converting it to success. Coordinate lease release/finalization with the same state ownership protocol.
